person_note: Paul Tracey is the participating first-person narrator of both the present-day reconciliation story and the 1973 flashbacks; the timeline shifts do not constitute alternation of narrative person. The input quotes themselves provide no diagnostic first-person base-narration signal: q02722 is demonstrably dialogue, q02723 contains imagined speech, and the remaining event excerpts are unmarked or locally unclear. One authorized Tier A excerpt strongly establishes Paul’s narration, and several explicit whole-book Tier C descriptions corroborate it with no credible contrary evidence. Confidence is therefore medium rather than high because quote support is absent and live research did not yield two usable Tier A/B sources.
